configs.description: The PDU as it ships, the IMD-5M module in its slot. The mounting brackets are not drawn.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: SL-71211 Rev E section 3 and its figures 3.1 to 3.14 show brackets and none is dimensioned or names the position the unit ships in. The ears are not drawn and no position is stated.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned outline drawing, or the mounting section of the SKU's data sheet.

gaps.note: no held maker document states a weight for any PDU. A community listing says 6.35 kg, which is not the maker's.
SL-71211 Rev E and the comparison sheet say Switched units carry the IMD-5M, drawn here; the SKU page's own image shows a four-digit LED display with three buttons.
gaps.wanted: which module the SKU ships with.

gaps.note: no held document says what colour an outlet lamp shows or what it means; the photographs show them unlit and white. The `on` state is declared with no colour.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of a powered unit.

gaps.note: the rating, poles and trip curve of the two breakers are in no held document.
gaps.wanted: the SKU's data sheet or nameplate.

gaps.note: the outlet trays and the outlets' depth are drawn flat. No view shows the trays in section or from the side.
gaps.wanted: a side photograph or a dimensioned drawing.

gaps.note: Figure 5.2 shows a socket with a network symbol, a socket under the USB port (callout 5, "Redundant power input") and a vertical slot. No held text names the first or the slot or the connector of the second, so they are drawn as shapes.
the touchscreen states 128 by 128 and no character count; it is drawn as a screen without the display vocabulary, which needs one.
no held photograph shows the top, the bottom or a side straight on; the front photograph shows the lid at a steep angle (a plain black lid). The four faces are drawn bare at the table's size.
gaps.wanted: straight-on photographs of the four faces.

breakers.note: photo-measured and estimated - the front shows two breakers, numbered 2 (green tab) at the left and 1 (orange tab) at the right. The rear shows the outlets in two groups whose tabs are orange for 1 to 6 and green for 7 to 12. THAT EACH GROUP RUNS THROUGH THE BREAKER OF ITS COLOUR IS A READING OF THE TWO PHOTOGRAPHS: no sentence held says it. The rating of the breakers is not stated in any held document.

capability.note: datasheet - the brochure p4 calls it "Switched, Unit-Level Monitoring", and the comparison sheet SL-70599 marks the LCD for Monitored and Switched. So `metering-scope: input` (unit level) and `outlet-switching: true`, the class `switched-metered-input` (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 2.2). The IMD-5M's text says "phase, line, and circuit current values" on the touchscreen (SL-71211 Rev E p35); no document says branch metering is per breaker for this SKU, so the scope stays at the unit.

chassis.note: datasheet - the SKU page's table: "Height 1.72 in", "Width 17 in", "Depth 12 in" (43.7, 431.8 and 304.8 mm). No weight is stated in a maker document. The 17 in is the body between the ear folds, because both photographs show a body with no flange; the 19 in rack face is the ears, which are not drawn. The rack unit count is not stated for the SKU; the brochure p7 says the line is "1U and 2U Horizontal" and 1.72 in is a 1U height. Colour photo-measured: the face's median is about #3f3f3d on the front and #313131 on the rear.

colours.note: photo-measured - the rear tabs read #fb5311 (orange) and #177734 (green); the front's orange bar #fb6b0c. The outlet nose reads #777674 and the well #040404; the tray's top bezel #7f7976. The front card's plate and the breaker frames are dark grey, #232222 to #2b2b2a. Those two are estimates from a lit photograph.

dcim.note: the input is one power port from vertiv/rpdu-cord-l6-30p@1 (type `other`, label NEMA L6-30P, as no type is held for the plug, so `input-plug: other`; L167) and each outlet a power outlet from vertiv/combo-outlet@1 (type `other`, label Vertiv combination C13/C19). NO feed_leg IS WRITTEN: a single-phase PDU is on whatever leg its plug is on (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 5.2). The module's ports export on its own module type.

ears.note: NOT DRAWN, AND NO POSITION IS STATED. SL-71211 Rev E section 3 has fourteen bracket figures (3.1 to 3.14) and says a horizontal PDU takes brackets (7 in-lb), but none names a position as the unit ships or dimensions one (gaps: ear-positions).

front.note: photo-measured - front photograph, mm from the face's left and top. Two breakers whose frames are 32.1 wide and start 31.6 and 104.1 from the left, number tabs above them. Twelve outlet lamps in two rows, 14.5 and 29.7 down, on a pitch of 8.6 from 254.3, numbered 1 to 6 above the upper row and 7 to 12 below the lower, with an orange bar 5.4 high at 19.4 down from 218 to 307 and a white disc, the maker's mark, centred at 235.9, on a label plate from 217.6 to 307.2 whose grey (#333331) is a shade darker than the face's #41413f. The IMD-5M plate from 308.8 across to 416.2. Four rivets round each breaker at the corners of a 41.9 by 19.8 rectangle.

input.note: datasheet - the SKU page prints "(30A, 200-240V)", a "power cord with a L6-30P plug" and "delivers 4.9 kW of power" in its description, and 50/60Hz in its table; the brochure p4 gives the input L6-30P. The cord is fixed because it leaves through a gland in the rear photograph, and `input-plug` is the slug the cord exports. The page does not say whether 30 A is the unit's or the plug's rating, so it is written as the unit's input current as printed. The brochure p7 calls the line "single phase electrical".

lifecycle.note: no held document announces an end of life. Not searched on the web: nothing is fetched for this model.

method.note: NO DRAWING EXISTS, SO EVERY POSITION IS READ OFF THE TWO STRAIGHT-ON PHOTOGRAPHS. Searched: the SKU page, the rack PDU brochure SL-20881, the product line comparison SL-70599, the installer/user guide SL-71211 Rev E (whose mounting figures 3.1 to 3.14 carry no dimension) and the quick installation guide SL-70646; none dimensions a face. vertiv-geist-switched-vp5n31a1_front.jpg and _rear.jpg are 1000 px square. The body reads 752 px across on the front and 764 on the rear for the SKU page's 17 in (431.8 mm), 1.74 and 1.77 px per mm. The face reads 71 to 73 px high for 1.72 in, 1.65 to 1.67 px per mm: the photographs look slightly down on the box, so vertical positions are good to about 1.5 mm and horizontal ones to about 0.7 mm. Nothing of known size is in frame to prove the scale a second way beyond the IMD-5M's RJ45 jacks, which read 16.6 wide against the part's 15.8.

module.note: datasheet - the module is vertiv/imd-5m@1 in a bay: SL-71211 Rev E 5.1.3 says all Monitored and Switched rPDUs ship with it. The SKU page's own image (vp51301_front.jpg) shows a different, LED-display card with three buttons; Rev C of the guide says previous versions shipped other modules. Which one a given unit carries is not stated (gaps: module-variant).

numbering.note: photo-measured - the rear prints 1 and 6 at the corners of the first group and 7 and 12 at the corners of the second; the front prints 1 to 12 over and under its lamps. Outlets 2 to 5 and 8 to 11 carry no number on the rear and are numbered by the front's sequence. THE LAMPS ARE `for: chassis`, NOT FOR THEIR OUTLETS: the lamps are on the front and the outlets on the rear, and L14 takes a `for` only in the same view, so a state set on an outlet does not reach its lamp.

outlets.note: datasheet - the SKU page table "Combination C13/C19 (12)", the brochure p4 "(12) C13/C19 Combo". The page's meta description says "(36)", which is the brochure's figure for a vertical SKU and not this one; the rear photograph shows twelve. Each is vertiv/combo-outlet@1 (Table 2.4 and 3.2.2 of SL-71211 Rev E), numbered as printed.

rear.note: photo-measured - rear photograph, mm from the face's left as seen from behind and from its top. The cord gland centred 23.0 across. Twelve combination outlets, 20.0 wide and 27.0 high, in two groups of six, the first outlet's left edge at 66.3 and the seventh's at 255.1, each group on a pitch of 27.0 (the six steps read 27.0 on both groups, and one empty pitch stands between the groups). A grey tray round each group, 60.5 to 227.2 and 252.7 to 416.6 across, with an orange or green tab above and below the outlets. 1 and 6 printed at the ends of the first group and 7 and 12 at the ends of the second.
